   476	def is_improvement(metric_name, change):
   477	    """Determine if change is improvement based on metric type"""
   478	    # Lower is better for these metrics

   484

print("\nQuestions per year and type:")
print(df.groupby(['year','type']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))

# Year-over-year change
year_counts = df.groupby('year').size().sort_index()
print("\nYear-over-year absolute change:")
print(year_counts.diff().dropna())
print("\nYear-over-year % change:")
print((year_counts.pct_change()*100).dropna().round(1))

# Average questions per type
avg_per_type = df.groupby('type').size() / df['year'].nunique()
print("\nAverage questions per type per year:")

# Topic keyword extraction from question text

all_text = []
for q in df['question'].dropna():
    # Split by $ to remove options/sub-parts for cleaner topic extraction
    parts = [p.strip() for p in str(q).split('$')]
    # First part is usually the actual question stem
    stem = parts[0] if parts else ""
    all_text.append(stem.lower())

# Define CS curriculum keywords relevant to BIEK CS
curriculum_keywords = {
    'loop': ['loop','for loop','while loop','do-while','do while','nested loop','iteration'],
    'if-else / switch': ['if-else','if else','nested if','switch','break','continue','goto','ternary','conditional'],

    'input/output (I/O)': ['printf','scanf','gets','puts','getc','putc','putchar','getchar','format specifier','escape sequence','stdio.h','conio.h'],

    'DBA': ['dba','database administrator'],
    'control structures': ['control structure','selection','sequence','decision making'],
    'programming basics': ['program','syntax error','logical error','runtime error','compiler','interpreter','source code','object code','algorithm','flowchart','pseudocode'],
    'C language specifics': ['c program','c language','preprocessor directive','#include','#define','header file','math.h','string.h','void','main()'],
}

# Count keyword matches per topic

    for text in all_text:

    topic_counts[topic] = count

print("\nTopic frequency counts (questions matching each topic):")
for topic, count in sorted(topic_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):

# Also compute per-year topic presence for trend analysis
year_topic_matrix = {}
for year in sorted(df['year'].unique()):

    for q in df[df['year']==year]['question'].dropna():

}
